headline: 157 new hospital admissions as two die of dengue in a day
summary: The nationwide death toll from the mosquito-borne virus has risen to 12 this year, according to the Directorate General of Health Services.
details: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reported two fresh dengue deaths in the last 24 hours, bringing the total death toll for the year to 12.
A total of 157 new patients were admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh over the same period.
In the capital, 28 new admissions were recorded in Dhaka North City Corporation and 29 in Dhaka South City Corporation.
Outside Dhaka, Barishal saw the highest number of new admissions with 56 cases, followed by Chattogram with 16 and Khulna with 10.
Other regional admissions included 11 in Dhaka division, 4 in Rajshahi and 3 in Mymensingh.
Since January 1, a total of 5,317 people have been hospitalized with dengue, and 4,919 have recovered and been discharged.

headline: Singer Momtaz shown arrested in attempted murder case
summary: Former MP and popular singer Momtaz Begum appeared in court wearing a bulletproof jacket and helmet for security.
details: A court has ordered that former Member of Parliament and popular singer Momtaz Begum be shown arrested in an attempted murder case.
The case is linked to the July uprising, involving allegations of violence during the protests.
Upon appearing in court, Momtaz Begum was seen wearing a bulletproof jacket and a helmet for her own protection.
The legal proceedings continue as the court processes the arrest order related to the uprising-linked charges.
